rw_hitchhiker_leash_26.description:
Inspired by climbing gear, the Hitch Hiker is a versatile product combining an adjustable leash and a fixation system. It flexibly converts into a handle, waist belt, or tree-securing strap to maximize the connection between the dog and handler in various situations.

Features
• Fluid length adjustment from long line to short leash using a 12 ft rope.
• Equipped with HitchLock™ auto-blocking technology that locks the rope under tension.
• Versatile use as a handle, hands-free waist belt, or single tree/post anchoring strap.
• Includes a durable stow bag to store the rope end for excellent portability.
• Ergonomic design allows for direct hand adjustment and acts as a braking system.

Specifications
• Rope length: 12 ft (3.65 m)
• Stow bag dimensions: 6 x 7 x 2 in (16 x 18.5 x 5 cm)
• Waist belt max length: 49"
• Country of manufacture: Vietnam

Materials and ingredients
• Back shell: bluesign® certified 150D polyester ripstop (DWR and PU coating)
• Rope: 7 mm reflective kernmantle rope
• Belt: 20 mm polyester webbing
• Hardware: Anodized 6061-T6 aluminum Lockable Crux Clip™ and HitchLock™ rope adjuster
• Buckle: bluesign® approved ITW Nexus Mach 1 side-release
• Zipper: YKK #3 reverse coil zipper

Use
• Manually adjust the HitchLock™ rope adjuster to lock or release the rope under tension.
• Use the strap as a handle to utilize it as a standard leash.
• Wear as a waist belt to use as a hands-free leash.
• Wrap and secure the strap around a single tree or post as a hitch.
• Store the rope end in the built-in stow bag for portability.

Care
• Hand wash recommended
• Use mild detergent.
• Air dry

Important information
• Auto-blocking technology only locks when the rope is under tension; you must manually adjust when releasing or pulling slack.
• Requires human supervision as this is a human-in-the-loop system.
• Maintains a safe distance as it acts as a braking system when the rope is under tension.

rw_spokespup_tag.name: Ruffwear SpokesPup Dog ID Tag
rw_spokespup_tag.description:
SpokesPup 4-in-1 Leash Tag

The SpokesPup Leash Tag lets you know how to approach your dog at a glance.

With 4 interchangeable cards, attach to the leash to intuitively let others know how to approach your dog.

Ask First: My owner's permission is needed to approach me.

In Training: I am currently in training. Please be considerate so I can focus on training.

No Dogs: I don't want to meet other dog friends right now.

Do Not Disturb: Please do not disturb me, both people and dog friends.

Interchangeable: You can swap double-sided cards in seconds. You can immediately switch to a card that fits your dog's current situation.

Highly Visible: Brightly colored cards visible from 20m away, and bold text and icons visible from 6m away, provide excellent visibility.

Easily Understood: Each card has a unique icon, text, and color, making it concise and easy to understand visually.

Rugged: The anti-slip design card holder is fixed so it doesn't move on the leash, and the cards are made of waterproof material and are tear-resistant. The card holder is compatible with most leashes. For flat leashes with widths from 0.64cm to 3.81cm, rope and chain leashes with a maximum diameter of 1.9cm. For narrower leashes, you can tie a knot below the desired attachment point to use it.

How to Use: 1. Open the SpokesPup card holder. 2. Select a pair of SpokesPup cards and insert them into the card holder. 3. Attach the SpokesPup holder to the leash. 4. We recommend attaching it to the bottom 1/3 of the leash.

1 SpokesPup card holder, 2 sets of double-sided SpokesPup cards (Green/Yellow + Orange/Red)

Product Size: SpokesPup card holder: 13.46 cm x 7.62 cm x 1.96 cm, SpokesPup card: 12.95 cm x 7.11 cm x 0.036 cm

Product Weight: 57 g

Product Materials: SpokesPup card holder: Ultralight Rubber, SpokesPup card: Flexible Waterproof Paper

rs_brachy_lens.name: Rex Specs Original Replacement Lenses for Brachycephalic Dogs
rs_brachy_lens.description:
This is a replacement lens exclusively for the original Rex Specs dog goggles. Made from premium material, it offers impact resistance and UV 400 sun protection.

Features
• Impact-resistant design protects against external shocks
• UV 400 rating blocks 99% of harmful UVA and UVB rays
• Clear lens features 92% visible light transmittance, suitable for training
• Smoke lens features 20% transmittance, maintaining visibility even against scratches
• Red Mirror lens features 23% transmittance to emphasize style
• Blue Mirror lens features 15% transmittance to ease sunlight sensitivity

Specifications
• Compatible Model: Original Rex Specs Dog Goggle
• Lens Color Options: Clear, Smoke, Red Mirror, Blue Mirror
• Quantity Options: Single, 3 Pack, Multi Pack
• Size Options: X-Large, Large, Medium, Small, X-Small, Small Wide
• UV Blocking Rate: 99% (UVA/UVB)
• Transmittance: Clear 92%, Smoke 20%, Red Mirror 23%, Blue Mirror 15%

Materials and ingredients
• Premium material

Use
• Remove the existing lens by holding and pulling the snout and top parts of the goggles
• First insert the new lens into the two tabs on the goggle snout part
• If there are side tabs, assemble them one by one until they click completely
• Align and assemble the top side tabs, then secure the top center tab last
• If assembly is difficult, gently shake the frame and lens left and right to find the optimal position

Important information
• Buying a spare lens is recommended as lenses scratch easily
• Use after confirming that all tabs are completely secured

rs_v2_black.name: Rex Specs V2 Black Frame Dog Goggles
rs_v2_black.description:
Rex Specs Goggles V2 provide stable and safe eye protection for everything from professional working dogs to everyday walking dogs. Designed to optimize a dog's vision and comfort in various adventure environments.

Features
• All lenses (including clear) block 99.9% of harmful ultraviolet rays (UVA/UVB).
• The impact-resistant lenses are replaceable and interchangeable.
• The dynamic strap system ensures a secure fit without restricting the dog's range of motion or performance.
• The single spherical lens design optimizes vision and provides comfort by securing space within the frame during extended wear.
• The ventilated frame drains quickly during water use and provides sufficient airflow to limit fogging.
• The flexible and durable frame is edged with foam for complete protection from debris.

Specifications
• Model: Goggles for Dogs - V2
• UV Protection Rate: 99.9% (UVA/UVB)
• Contents Quantity: 1 piece (goggles body)
• Included Lenses: 1 clear lens, 1 smoke lens
• Additional Components: Microfiber storage bag
• Special Version: LIMITED EDITION LIBERTY GOGGLE (Patterns vary individually)

Materials and ingredients
• Impact-resistant lens
• Flexible frame material
• Foam edge
• Dynamic strap system
• Ventilated frame
• Microfiber storage bag

Use
• Securely fit to the dog's head using the dynamic strap system.
• Use interchangeably by replacing the clear lens and smoke lens as needed.
• Allow rapid drainage through the frame's ventilation holes when used in water.
• Maintain clear vision and comfort during extended wear with the single spherical lens design.
• Store in the microfiber storage bag after use.

Care
• Remove moisture after use and dry in a well-ventilated area.
• Gently wash the lens and frame to remove debris.
• Store in the microfiber bag to protect against dust and scratches.
• Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high-temperature environments.

Important information
• While the lenses are impact-resistant, they are not indestructible, so avoid excessive impact.
• Be careful not to obstruct the dog's range of motion or breathing when adjusting the straps.
• Please note that the pattern of the LIMITED EDITION LIBERTY GOGGLE varies by product.
• After using in water, wait until the moisture inside the frame drains completely.

Brand: Rex Specs
Manufacturer: REX SPECS
Country of origin: Taiwan OEM
Category: Accessories
Options: L, M, S, XL, XS

rs_v2_pikepurple.name: Rex Specs V2 Pike Purple Frame Dog Goggles
rs_v2_pikepurple.description:
Rex Specs Goggles V2 provide stable and safe eye protection for everything from professional working dogs to everyday walking dogs. Designed to optimize a dog's vision and comfort in various adventure environments.

Features
• All lenses (including clear) block 99.9% of harmful ultraviolet rays (UVA/UVB).
• The impact-resistant lenses are replaceable and interchangeable.
• The dynamic strap system ensures a secure fit without restricting the dog's range of motion or performance.
• The single spherical lens design optimizes vision and provides comfort by securing space within the frame during extended wear.
• The ventilated frame drains quickly during water use and provides sufficient airflow to limit fogging.
• The flexible and durable frame is edged with foam for complete protection from debris.

Specifications
• Model: Goggles for Dogs - V2
• UV Protection Rate: 99.9% (UVA/UVB)
• Contents Quantity: 1 piece (goggles body)
• Included Lenses: 1 clear lens, 1 smoke lens
• Additional Components: Microfiber storage bag
• Special Version: LIMITED EDITION LIBERTY GOGGLE (Patterns vary individually)

Materials and ingredients
• Impact-resistant lens
• Flexible frame material
• Foam edge
• Dynamic strap system
• Ventilated frame
• Microfiber storage bag

Use
• Securely fit to the dog's head using the dynamic strap system.
• Use interchangeably by replacing the clear lens and smoke lens as needed.
• Allow rapid drainage through the frame's ventilation holes when used in water.
• Maintain clear vision and comfort during extended wear with the single spherical lens design.
• Store in the microfiber storage bag after use.

Care
• Remove moisture after use and dry in a well-ventilated area.
• Gently wash the lens and frame to remove debris.
• Store in the microfiber bag to protect against dust and scratches.
• Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high-temperature environments.

Important information
• While the lenses are impact-resistant, they are not indestructible, so avoid excessive impact.
• Be careful not to obstruct the dog's range of motion or breathing when adjusting the straps.
• Please note that the pattern of the LIMITED EDITION LIBERTY GOGGLE varies by product.
• After using in water, wait until the moisture inside the frame drains completely.

Brand: Rex Specs
Manufacturer: REX SPECS
Country of origin: Taiwan OEM
Category: Accessories
Options: L, M, S, XL, XS

rs_lens_original.name: Rex Specs Original Replacement Lenses
rs_lens_original.description:
This is a replacement lens exclusively for the original Rex Specs dog goggles. Made from premium material, it offers impact resistance and UV 400 sun protection.

Features
• Impact-resistant design protects against external shocks
• UV 400 rating blocks 99% of harmful UVA and UVB rays
• Clear lens features 92% visible light transmittance, suitable for training
• Smoke lens features 20% transmittance, maintaining visibility even against scratches
• Red Mirror lens features 23% transmittance to emphasize style
• Blue Mirror lens features 15% transmittance to ease sunlight sensitivity

Specifications
• Compatible Model: Original Rex Specs Dog Goggle
• Lens Color Options: Clear, Smoke, Red Mirror, Blue Mirror
• Quantity Options: Single, 3 Pack, Multi Pack
• Size Options: X-Large, Large, Medium, Small, X-Small, Small Wide
• UV Blocking Rate: 99% (UVA/UVB)
• Transmittance: Clear 92%, Smoke 20%, Red Mirror 23%, Blue Mirror 15%

Materials and ingredients
• Premium material

Use
• Remove the existing lens by holding and pulling the snout and top parts of the goggles
• First insert the new lens into the two tabs on the goggle snout part
• If there are side tabs, assemble them one by one until they click completely
• Align and assemble the top side tabs, then secure the top center tab last
• If assembly is difficult, gently shake the frame and lens left and right to find the optimal position

Important information
• Buying a spare lens is recommended as lenses scratch easily
• Use after confirming that all tabs are completely secured

Brand: Rex Specs
Manufacturer: REX SPECS
Country of origin: Taiwan OEM
Category: Goggles/Lenses/Hearing Protection
Options: L, M, S, XL, XS, Green Mirror, Red Mirror, Blue Mirror, Smoke, Silver Mirror, Transparent Clear

Features
• All lenses (including clear) block 99.9% of harmful ultraviolet rays (UVA/UVB).
• The impact-resistant lenses are replaceable and interchangeable.
• The dynamic strap system ensures a secure fit without restricting the dog's range of motion or performance.
• The single spherical lens design optimizes vision and provides comfort by securing space within the frame during extended wear.
• The ventilated frame drains quickly during water use and provides sufficient airflow to limit fogging.
• The flexible and durable frame is edged with foam for complete protection from debris.

Specifications
• Model: Goggles for Dogs - V2
• UV Protection Rate: 99.9% (UVA/UVB)
• Contents Quantity: 1 piece (goggles body)
• Included Lenses: 1 clear lens, 1 smoke lens
• Additional Components: Microfiber storage bag
• Special Version: LIMITED EDITION LIBERTY GOGGLE (Patterns vary individually)

Materials and ingredients
• Impact-resistant lens
• Flexible frame material
• Foam edge
• Dynamic strap system
• Ventilated frame
• Microfiber storage bag

Use
• Securely fit to the dog's head using the dynamic strap system.
• Use interchangeably by replacing the clear lens and smoke lens as needed.
• Allow rapid drainage through the frame's ventilation holes when used in water.
• Maintain clear vision and comfort during extended wear with the single spherical lens design.
• Store in the microfiber storage bag after use.

Care
• Remove moisture after use and dry in a well-ventilated area.
• Gently wash the lens and frame to remove debris.
• Store in the microfiber bag to protect against dust and scratches.
• Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high-temperature environments.

Important information
• While the lenses are impact-resistant, they are not indestructible, so avoid excessive impact.
• Be careful not to obstruct the dog's range of motion or breathing when adjusting the straps.
• Please note that the pattern of the LIMITED EDITION LIBERTY GOGGLE varies by product.
• After using in water, wait until the moisture inside the frame drains completely.

Brand: Rex Specs
Manufacturer: REX SPECS
Country of origin: Taiwan OEM
Category: Accessories
Options: L, M, S, XL, XS

rw_collar_nota.name: Ruffwear Knot-a-Collar
rw_collar_nota.description:
KNOT-A-COLLAR™ Reflective Rope Collar

The Knot-a-Collar is a clean and elegant dog collar that combines design and durability.

The 7mm rope with reflective trim fits comfortably under the fur and can be adjusted to the optimal fit with the sliding fisherman's knot.

The aluminum V-ring provides a secure connection, and the reflective trim ensures excellent visibility at night.

The Knot-a-Collar perfectly matches the color of the Knot-a-Leash.

1 Low Profile The 7mm rope with reflective trim sits comfortably against the dog's fur.

2 Secure Connection The anodized, one-piece aluminum V-ring is a secure leash attachment point. Although the aluminum V-ring is manufactured with an anodized coating, due to the nature of the metal material, metal powder may rub off due to repeated friction.

3 Comfortable Fit The size can be adjusted to fit the dog's neck using the knot method on the ultra-lightweight rope, and it sits comfortably under the dog's fur, making it a suitable collar for daily wear without needing to be removed.

4 Reflective Kernmantle Rope Uses professional mountaineering kernmantle rope, which is strong yet elastic, and features reflective trim to increase visibility in low light at night.

Brand: Ruffwear
Manufacturer: Ruffwear
Country of origin: Made in Vietnam (JSK GLOBAL)
Category: Collar
Options: Moss Green, Blue Pool, Obsidian Black, Fireweed Pink

bm_kibble_9kg.description:
Billy + Margot® is a high-quality, nature-friendly dog diet created by famous Australian canine nutritionist Marie Jones, based on her love, passion, and professional expertise.

Packed with high-quality protein and superfoods, Billy + Margot®'s healthy dog diet contains no unnecessary grains and is specially designed to fully meet a dog's complex dietary needs.

Billy + Margot® products feature a variety of ingredients, providing diversity, deep flavor, and optimal nutrition.

Billy + Margot is a member of the reputable Pet Food Industry Association of Australia (PFIAA).

PFIAA members must meet the AS5812 Australian Standard for pet food manufacturing. This is a rigorous requirement that must satisfy not only product ingredients but also additives, preservatives, product labeling guidelines, and hygiene standards.

I, Ryan Monaghan, Group Regulatory Affairs Manager for Billy + Margot, declare that the meat meal used in Billy + Margot never includes diseased animals or roadkill, in order to maintain high-quality protein.

Excellent meat meal is a powder that concentrates high levels of quality protein. It also contains not only protein but also essential amino acids & fatty acids, and natural minerals such as calcium & phosphorus.

The meat meal used in Billy + Margot is designed to provide not only the nutrients obtainable from muscle meat but also the essential nutrients that can only be obtained from animal organs.

We believe this provides a much higher quality meal than simply providing muscle meat.

Furthermore, to consistently supply these high-quality products to Korea, the products we export to Korea always undergo sampling and a risk analysis test program, and are exported with an attached certificate of analysis.

Billy + Margot uses only animal-welfare beef and lamb, and wild kangaroo meat raised roaming in the pristine nature of Australia.

Animal-welfare beef and lamb are raised healthily, free from antibiotics and hormones, in a free and psychologically happy environment, feeling nature and the wind.

Also, Billy + Margot does not use poultry such as chicken, turkey, or duck to maximize the characteristics of the protein source.

For friends suffering from allergies or tear stains, we have delicately designed the formula by using fat from the same meat source as the protein, rather than the chicken fat commonly used by most.

Manuka honey is honey made by bees consuming nectar from Manuka flowers; unlike regular honey, it is called medicinal honey.

This honey contains 100 times more methylglyoxal than regular honey, a component that is very effective in eliminating Helicobacter pylori bacteria associated with stomach diseases.

In addition, it has various benefits such as immune system enhancement, anti-cancer effects, skin regeneration promotion, and antibacterial action.

yora_stew_carrotpotato_390g.description:
For all breeds, adult dogs 12 months and older

58% Black Soldier Fly (fresh Black Soldier Fly)

Grain-free, hypoallergenic

Natural prebiotics for gut health

Yora Pâté is a perfectly balanced grain-free & hypoallergenic wet food for adult dogs 12 months and older.

Maintains moisture balance, rich taste and soft texture for increased palatability!! Rich in natural antioxidants!!

NUTRITIOUS INSECTS: Single protein from the most nutritious and eco-friendly American Black Soldier Fly

GRAIN FREE: Grain-free. No wheat, soy, corn, by-products, preservatives, or artificial colors.

HYPOALLERGENIC: Perfect wet food for dogs sensitive to meat allergies.

NATURAL PREBIOTICS: Added natural prebiotics MOS & FOS for dog gut health.

ANTIOXIDANTS: Contains carrots rich in fiber and Vitamin A, and low-glycemic potatoes for increased palatability and rich antioxidants.

MOISTURE: Up to 74% moisture content, helpful for dogs that do not drink enough water.

Eco-friendly Tetra Pak packaging: Globally recognized for safety, Tetra Pak protects contents from light, temperature, and bacteria, and allows for safe storage at room temperature.

Crude protein 10%, Crude fat 5%, Crude fiber 2%, Crude ash 2%, Moisture 74%, MOS 0.09%, FOS 0.09%

Fresh Black Soldier Fly (58%), vegetable broth, carrots (6%), potatoes (6%), pea protein, brewer's yeast (1.5%), minerals (0.2%), prebiotic MOS (yeast 0.09%), prebiotic FOS (chicory meal 0.09%).

Recommended Daily Feeding Amount (Weight 1~10kg: Up to 1⅓, 10~20kg: 1⅓ to 2¼, 20~30kg: 2¼ to 3, 30~40kg: 3 to 3⅔, 40~50kg: 3⅔ to 4⅓, 50~60+kg: 4⅓ to 5)

TIP: When feeding as a topper, adjust according to the dog's age and activity level. Feeding amounts may vary slightly depending on age, activity, climate, and breed. For overweight dogs, feed 10% less than the recommended amount; for underweight dogs, feed 10% more. After opening, store in the refrigerator and consume as soon as possible. Do not feed to animals other than dogs. If using a microwave, be sure to transfer to a separate container.

To help your dog adapt to YORA, start by mixing about 25% YORA with their existing food on the first day, and increase to 100% YORA by the 7th day.

All dogs' appetites vary by size, age, condition, and activity level. Adjust the given amount to keep your dog healthy and active. Always feed with fresh water. After opening, store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.

TopLife Goat Milk has passed the strict standards of the UK Vegetarian Society and has received vegetarian certification.

TopLife Goat Milk uses 100% goat milk, making it richer in calcium. To preserve the unique characteristics of goat milk, it does not undergo a homogenization process, resulting in minimal nutrient loss.

What is homogenization? It is a process that breaks down the fat globules contained in raw milk to prevent the fat and cream layers from separating.

Ingredients: Goat milk, Inulin 10.7 g/kg, Green tea extract (292 mg/kg), Glucosamine (930 mg/kg), Chondroitin (470 mg/kg)

Country of origin: Germany, Manufacturer: Delamere Dairy in United Kingdom

Recommended serving size per meal: Dogs under 5kg: 70ml, 5-10kg: 100-180ml, over 10kg: 200-250ml / Cats: 10ml per 1kg of body weight

Store at room temperature before opening. After opening, keep refrigerated and feed within 3 days if possible.

Sensitive reactions may occur depending on the pet's constitution; if they persist, discontinue feeding.

Due to the natural components of goat milk, floating matter or sediment may occasionally appear, but the product is safe. Please shake well before feeding.

Treats should not exceed 10% of a pet's daily intake. Please pay attention to feeding amounts.

Always provide fresh water.

When feeding for the first time, we recommend mixing it with a moderate amount of food or treats, or starting with a small amount.

FOR DOGS: For adult and senior dogs. Can also be consumed by cats.

fumble_shampoobar_camelrose.description:
Premium cold-process soap made with birch sap.

Birch sap, extracted from birch trees, is called the queen of saps. It is harvested when the tree's transpiration is active, specifically when the temperature difference between day and night is between 10°C and 15°C, making the harvesting period very short.

Birch sap contains rich organic acids, minerals, amino acids, and the triterpene compound betulin, which provides anti-cancer, soothing, and anti-aging effects.

The pumpkin-shaped Pumblepet soap, with its soft curves, is a 100% handmade product. Each one is crafted individually in a single-cavity mold to create a size that fits perfectly in the hand.

Main Ingredients: Birch sap, camellia oil, organic extra virgin coconut oil, palm oil, sodium hydroxide, rose absolute, and other aroma blending oils.

Camellia oil, used as the main moisturizing oil, is light and absorbs quickly, containing rich Omega 3, 6, 9 fatty acids, Vitamin E, and polyphenols. With high moisturizing power and over 85% oleic acid content, it provides antioxidant effects, restores moisture balance, improves skin, and helps with wrinkle improvement.

TURKEY GREEN SOAP: Recommended for oily skin, greasy dandruff, when the body has an odor, or for itchy or troubled fur.

Main Ingredients: Birch sap, laurel berry oil (INCL: Laurus nobilis), natural betaine, sodium hydroxide, and others.

The laurel berry oil used as the main oil is the raw material for Aleppo soap, manufactured in Aleppo, Syria, and is an oil with a deep tradition dating back to when humans first started making soap. Laurel berry oil has antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and soothing effects.

HERB t.t SOAP: Recommended for skin with weak immunity, skin prone to frequent infections, dry/rough fur, and normal fur.

Main Ingredients: Birch sap, organic extra virgin coconut oil, palm oil, Ayurveda Doctor's Health Herb Pack, sodium hydroxide, tea tree and aroma blending oils, and others.

The Ayurveda Doctor's Health Herb Pack, an animal herb pack, uses main ingredients such as aloe neem and cassia flower herbs that have received various global organic certifications including JAS and ECO CERT. It is used for infected skin with weak immunity or skin that requires care.

Virgin coconut oil is not subjected to high heat compared to regular coconut oil, so it contains over 50% lauric acid, a saturated fatty acid, providing excellent moisturizing.

The skin layer of pets consists of 3 structural layers, which are thinner than humans, and maintains a slightly alkaline level of around pH 7.5, unlike the slightly acidic skin of humans.

Pumblepet soap's natural soap is the most nature-friendly soap for pets' skin and fur, and does not use any chemical ingredients.

NO artificial colors, NO parabens, NO synthetic fragrances, NO chemical synthetic surfactants, NO silicone oil.

It has excellent physical properties such as resilience and shock absorption, as well as good processability and lightweight characteristics. It is easily deformable at high temperatures, making it recyclable.

TPE material does not release environmental hormones even when exposed to microwaves or hot water, and can be used safely without deformation.

icecream_realcheese.name: Handmade/Other Dog Handmade Ice Cream Real Cheese Pocket
icecream_realcheese.description:
Mungry is a specialty store for handmade pet snacks that has received a supplementary feed manufacturing license and completed ingredient registration in accordance with the Feed Management Act. It is free of preservatives, additives, and artificial colors. All products are manufactured under strict management in a 100% in-house production system within a hygienic environment in our offline store.

All snacks are made to order sequentially for freshness, so it takes at least 3 to 7 days (excluding weekends and holidays) for delivery. Please check the delivery time and order with enough time. + Please check the ingredients of the snack to ensure there are no ingredients your pet is allergic to.

Real Cheese Pocket 5p (70g)

Ingredients: Milk (Domestic/Yonsei Milk), Red Beet (Domestic), Carrot (Domestic), Mango (Peru), Broccoli (Guatemala), Blueberry (Chile), Lemon Juice (Italy)

It is a Real Cheese Pocket that captures the soft texture of handmade fresh cheese :D Because we grind red beet, carrot, mango, broccoli, and blueberries ourselves, you can taste the savory flavor of the cheese itself and the sweetness of the fruits and vegetables using only the listed ingredients.

You can take a cheese pocket with you when going for a walk to eat it cool, or add a different cheese pocket every day to any meal—kibble, cooked food, or raw food—to make it delicious. Especially in summer, if you serve it cold like ice cream, you can have a cool time without stomach upset thanks to the light pocket size :)

X. Real Cheese Pocket Essential Information. Do not feed the cheese directly from the container. Your pet's tongue could be injured by the sharp edges of the container.

Tip for removing the cheese pocket cleanly. Keep it frozen, and take it out 10 minutes before feeding. When slightly thawed, press it like an ice tray to pop it out. Due to the nature of fresh cheese, it may not separate cleanly from the container if stored in the refrigerator or fully thawed. Please be sure to store in the freezer after receipt.

rw_jsk_1000000164.name: Ruffwear Swamp Cooler Cooling Vest
rw_jsk_1000000164.description:
The Swamp Cooler™ Cooling Vest protects skin from UV rays and provides a cooling effect using the principle of water evaporation.

It provides effective cooling so dogs can run and play outdoors even in the hot summer. Since it uses water, it is easy to maintain; if it dries out after rolling around and playing, simply re-wet it and wring it out.

It also features a leash portal, allowing it to be worn over a harness.

1 UPF 50+ Coverage

This cooling vest covers the dog's entire body and features on/off buckles on both sides for easy wear. It is made with a powerful UPF 50+ UV protection rating to provide continuous skin protection.

2 Leash Portal

There is a leash portal on the back, allowing a harness to be worn underneath.

3 Three-layer construction for cooling

It uses a three-layer material structure made of top-quality materials to maximize the cooling effect, backed by our original development know-how and technical data.

The cooling performance of the Swamp Cooler was tested using a FLIR thermal imaging camera. You can verify its effective cooling ability, which reduced temperatures from 106° F / 41° C before wearing to 74.3° F / 23.5° C after wearing.

XXS: 33-43 cm

XS: 43-56 cm

S: 56-69 cm

M: 69-81 cm

L: 81-91 cm

XL: 91-107 cm

LENGTH (A) | NECK (B) | SIZE

24.5 cm | 34.5 cm | XXS

31 cm | 41cm | XS

43.5 cm | 50 cm | S

51 cm | 56 cm | M

56.5 cm | 67.5 cm | L

61 cm | 71 cm | XL

WASHING INSTRUCTIONS: Hand wash using a neutral detergent. Dry in a well-ventilated area away from direct sunlight. If using a washing machine, fasten the buckles and wash on a gentle cycle with cold water. Do not use bleach, iron, or dry clean.

MATERIALS: SHELL Air Mesh, BUCKLES ITW Nexus Waveloc side-release buckles

EVAPORATIVE COOLING: When you come out of a lake, you can feel a cool sensation when your skin first touches the air. When water evaporates, it absorbs surrounding heat, causing evaporative cooling which lowers the ambient temperature. The principle of Ruffwear cooling gear utilizes this evaporative cooling of water.

Ruffwear cooling gear is made with a 50+ UPF protection rating (blocking 98% of solar UV rays), providing powerful UV protection to protect your dog's skin.
